Powerful earthquake hits Japan, over 150,000 evacuated

A 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck Japan on Tuesday, prompting the evacuation of over 150,000 people and causing widespread damage. The Japanese government issued emergency warnings for several prefectures, including Kumamoto, where a shopping mall collapsed. Trains were halted, and airports closed due to the quake's impact.
